check: the exact shape of the ledger update the closing step must make, written before it is needed
why: The last step edits a delivered document under time pressure. Recording the field-by-field shape in advance turns it from a judgement call into a mechanical edit, and makes it obvious if something does not fit the expected pattern.

fieldsAndWhatHappens.title: unchanged - it lists what the entry covers
fieldsAndWhatHappens.expected: unchanged - it states the condition, not the result
fieldsAndWhatHappens.status: NOT_RUN becomes PASS only if the report says passed true and durationMet true; otherwise it stays NOT_RUN with the failure recorded
fieldsAndWhatHappens.log: unchanged - build/s5-stress-24h2.log remains the live path until the clean removes it
fieldsAndWhatHappens.actual: rewritten with this run's measured figures: observedSeconds, requestedSeconds, completedChunks, refills, peak heap and checkpoints

theExistingStartedUtcVerified: It reads 2026-10-07T00:47:00Z, and the run started at 08:47 local. Under UTC+8 that converts to exactly 00:47Z, so the recorded value is right.
whatMakesThisMechanical: There is no field whose meaning has to be decided at the time. The only inputs are the report's own values, and the only branch is the one the ledger's rule already states.
